Standard PhD Fellowships
Standard PhD fellowships are offered by ICFO to outstanding PhD candidates who wish to pursue their PhD studies in any of our research groups.
General Eligibility Requirements
Find information about the general eligibility requirements of the PhD positions at ICFO in the General Eligibility Requirements section.
Priority Criteria for Joan Oró Grants
Find information about the priority criteria and system that will be applied at ICFO for Joan Oró Grants through this form, standardized by AGAUR.
Here you will find the prioritization of candidates resulting from the application of the criteria described above. Please note that there is a 10-day period to submit any objections to the ranking.
To do so, please contact the Academics Affairs Team at academicaffairs@icfo.eu
Conditions
The Standard PhD Fellowships cover a 6-month Trainee Period and 4-year PhD Period, (or until the thesis defence if this occurs before the end of the 4-year PhD Period).
Find more information about the general conditions and structure of the PhD positions at ICFO here.
All PhD Candidates must apply to a call through ICFO’s Job Opportunities website: ICFOjobs.
For complete information about the PhD Admissions process at ICFO, please see the Selection Process section and the open call on ICFOjobs website
